craft_notes: Sthāyin same work-voice; color: longing-awakened. End-weight endless (ananta uncut). L3 sings; L4 recognizes. REJECTED OPTIONS (with killers): (a) explaining endless -> killed: endless is the close. (b) thunder->storm kept: thunder thunders. Read aloud: CLOUDS-thun-der-ing MAKE-trav-el-ers-LONG … SORR-ow GROWS in THOSE, END-less. Abhinavagupta frame: rasa shifting śṛṅgāra → vīra/adbhuta — lover's voice yielding to poet's; sthāyibhāva (love) resolving into camatkāra (wonder at craft); seal names its own vessel.

l4.sanskrit_cite: utkaṇṭhayanti pathikāṇ jaladāḥ svanantaḥ śoko vivardhati ca tadvinatāsv anantaḥ

c1_essence: The rasa shifts from śṛṅgāra to vira/adbhuta: love and landscape are framed by the poet's skill, not by love alone. Clouds thundering make travelers long; sorrow grows, endless. Lovers honor the love-festival; cloud-arrival, dear friend, they bring. Then the tribute: may I be conquered by which poet, by yamakas; to him I pour water in ghaṭakarpara. The sthāyibhāva (love) resolves into the poet's own delight (camatkāra) at his craft. The potsherd is both vessel and namesake — the potsherd names itself at its close.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vira/adbhuta (heroic skill + wonder at craft), resolving from śṛṅgāra
